name: llmc_permute
goal: Port permute_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/permute.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> dim1 dim2 dim3 dim4` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 1e-05 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so delete it (delete_file) once your own port is done. migrate's output can be long: read it in parts (read_file offset/limit) or work from the CUDA harness.

museport.note: Dims unchanged from permute.cu main: 24,42,20,32 (~645K elements, ~2.6MB per buffer); CPU reference already finishes in milliseconds.
